reasoning: The September statement introduces explicit forward guidance on tapering, stating that 'a moderation in the pace of asset purchases may soon be warranted,' a meaningful step beyond July's vaguer language that 'the economy has made progress' and the Committee 'will continue to assess progress in coming meetings.' This signals an imminent shift in the dominant policy tool (balance sheet) and effectively pre-commits to beginning the taper, a material change in forward guidance even though the funds rate stance is unchanged.
key_quote: If progress continues broadly as expected, the Committee judges that a moderation in the pace of asset purchases may soon be warranted.
